curation.notes: Home-built magnetic tweezers (voice-coil-actuated permanent magnets, Olympus IX73, Ximea CMOS camera) applying constant (force-clamp) and oscillatory forces to three single-point variants (S47, P47, V47) of cadherin-23 covalently tethered via sortase A between surface and M-270 beads; I27 unfolding used as a specific-tether fingerprint. Force calibrated from DNA B-S overstretching. Includes all-atom MD, FISST and UNRES simulations.

evidence.snippet: our time-resolution is about 2 ms (580 Hz data acquisition rate)

entities.name: Cadherin-23 variants S47, P47 and V47

evidence.snippet: We performed the molecular dynamics simulation for all three proteins (S47, P47, and V47) using the QuickMD plugin in VMD52. The crystal structure solved for the S47 and P47 was taken from PDB database.
Specific events were identified by observing three or more distinct unfolding features of I27 at high force (>100 pN)
